**Applied Mathematics · Scientific Computing · Scientific Machine Learning**

I am an undergraduate student in Applied and Computational Mathematics at the Federal University of Goiás (UFG), Brazil. My interests include mathematical modeling of complex systems, numerical methods, scientific machine learning, optimization and uncertainty quantification.

## Current work

- **Helios** — physics-guided energy forecasting and stochastic optimization (in development).
- **Conjectura** — independent exploration of open mathematical conjectures with AI and formal verification.
- [Computational Mathematics](https://github.com/gustavobernardo1/computational-mathematics) — numerical methods and optimization studies.
- [Scientific ML](https://github.com/gustavobernardo1/scientific-ml) — inverse problems and physics-guided learning studies.
